attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Utah state income tax. Flat 4.5% rate (Utah Code § 59-10-104, 2025; reduced from 4.55% by HB 106) on AGI minus per-dependent personal exemption ($2,111). Utah's Taxpayer Tax Credit (6% × deductions+exemptions, phased out at 1.3% above thresholds) is omitted in this implementation — a follow-up will add it. Writes result.ut_taxable_income, result.ut_tax, result.ut_state_tax.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.ut_tax = 0; set result.ut_state_tax = 0; set result.ut_taxable_income = 0; add " Utah Tax Calculation (Form TC-40) - flat 4.5%" to job.audit_trail
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: 0 cvd /result.ut_tax xdef 0 cvd /result.ut_state_tax xdef 0 cvd /result.ut_taxable_income xdef " Utah Tax Calculation (Form TC-40) - flat 4.5%" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Always compute (UT has no filing-status differences in rate)

action_details.action_comment: UT taxable income = max(AGI − dependent_exemption × #dependents, 0); tax = 4.5% × taxable_income
action_details.action_dsl: set result.ut_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - length of job.dependents * ut_personal_exemption) and 0.0; set result.ut_tax = result.ut_taxable_income * ut_tax_rate; set result.ut_state_tax = result.ut_tax; add " UT taxable income (AGI - $2,111 per dependent): $" + result.ut_taxable_income to job.audit_trail; add " UT state tax (4.5%): $" + result.ut_state_tax to job.audit_trail
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi job.dependents length ut_personal_exemption fmul f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.ut_taxable_income xdef result.ut_taxable_income ut_tax_rate fmul cvd /result.ut_tax xdef result.ut_tax cvd /result.ut_state_tax xdef " UT taxable income (AGI - $2,111 per dependent): $" result.ut_taxable_income strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " UT state tax (4.5%): $" result.ut_state_tax strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Utah military retirement exclusion. Skeleton — see issue #446. UT allows up to $10,000 exemption on military retirement pay with income caps ($50k Single / $65k MFJ AGI); must choose between military retirement or Social Security exemption.
